entries.title: Psalms 58:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David.>> Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men? {Altaschith...: or, Destroy not} {Michtam: or, A golden Psalm}

words.text: ? {Altaschith...: or, Destroy not} {Michtam: or, A golden Psalm}

entries.title: Psalms 58:2
segments: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 58:3
segments: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies. {as soon...: Heb. from the belly}

words.text: as soon as they be born

entries.title: Psalms 58:4
segments: Their poison [is] like the poison of a serpent: [they are] like the deaf adder [that] stoppeth her ear; {like the poison: Heb. according to the likeness, etc} {adder: or, asp}

words.text: ; {like the poison: Heb. according to the likeness, etc} {adder: or, asp}

entries.title: Psalms 58:5
segments: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely. {charming...: or, be the charmer never so cunning}

words.text: . {charming...: or, be the charmer never so cunning}

entries.title: Psalms 58:6
segments: ¶Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.

entries.title: Psalms 58:7
segments: Let them melt away as waters [which] run continually: [when] he bendeth [his bow to shoot] his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.

words.text: , let them be as cut in pieces

entries.title: Psalms 58:8
segments: As a snail [which] melteth, let [every one of them] pass away: [like] the untimely birth of a woman, [that] they may not see the sun.

words.text: , let [every one of them] pass away

entries.title: Psalms 58:9
segments: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in [his] wrath. {both...: Heb. as living as wrath}

words.text: , he shall take them away as with a whirlwind

entries.title: Psalms 58:10
segments: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

entries.title: Psalms 58:11
segments: So that a man shall say, Verily [there is] a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth. {a reward...: Heb. fruit of the, etc}
